summary: iter-9 security module testing: 21 backend pytest tests (all PASS) + frontend UI smoke (buyer desktop + mobile + seller desktop). Validated /api/security/posture (7 features true, 3+ calendars, audit head>0), security headers (HSTS/X-Frame-Options:DENY/nosniff/Referrer-Policy/Permissions-Policy), brute-force lockout at 6th attempt (HTTP 429 with 'try again' message), password complexity rejection (<8/no-digit/no-letter all 422), audit chain entries have seq/prev_hash/content_hash, role-gated /api/security/audit/verify (buyer 403, seller 403), proof list/detail exclude ots_bytes, /download returns binary with OpenTimestamps magic header bytes, /upgrade gracefully handles pending proofs (upgraded:false, btc_block_height:null), /verify multipart with correct-digest=true / wrong-digest=false / bad-format=400, AES-256-GCM upload/download round-trip with 1024-byte all-byte-value blob (sha256 + bytes both match). Frontend: [data-testid='security-page'] renders 4 posture tiles + proofs list + .ots download/upgrade buttons + verifier modal. Chain verifier hidden for non-admin (buyer + seller both). Both BUYER_NAV and SELLER_NAV sidebars include Security entry under 'Platform' group. Mobile (390x844): page renders with stacked tiles, bottom tab bar still shows 5 tabs. No regressions detected.

VerifierModal handles file+digest, lowercases digest, and shows good/error iconography. Result block correctly differentiates pending vs Bitcoin-confirmed.
Frontend gracefully handles 0 proofs (empty state copy 'No proofs yet. Sign an NDA, upload a Vault file…') — good UX.

Backend test confirmed: GridFS metadata has encrypted:true + encryption_alg='AES-256-GCM' on new uploads; download decrypts bytes-identical. AAD binding (roomid:fileid) verified implicitly by round-trip success.

Legacy audit_logs (pre-iter-9) don't have seq/prev_hash/content_hash fields. Chain verifier walks only chain-aware entries (filter {seq: $exists}). This is correct — the chain is forward-only from the deploy point. No backfill needed but document in security console.
